settings.poll_interval.label: Poll interval
settings.poll_interval.description: Seconds between unread checks while no conversation is open.
settings.active_poll_interval.label: Active poll interval
settings.active_poll_interval.descriptio: Seconds between refreshes of the open conversation.
settings.sync_interval.label: Read-state sync interval
settings.sync_interval.description: Seconds between full read-cursor syncs with Slack.
settings.history_limit.label: History limit
settings.history_limit.description: Messages fetched per page of a conversation.
settings.max_watched.label: Watched conversations
settings.max_watched.description: Maximum conversations polled for unread counts.
settings.side.label: Sidebar edge
settings.side.description: Which screen edge the sidebar docks to. Width is fixed in plugin.toml.
settings.notify_dms.label: Notify on direct messages
settings.notify_dms.description: Send a desktop notification for new DMs and group DMs.
settings.notify_mentions.label: Notify on mentions
settings.notify_mentions.description: Send a desktop notification when a channel message mentions you.
settings.mark_read_on_open.label: Mark read on open
settings.mark_read_on_open.description: Clear the unread badge when a conversation is opened.
settings.archive_messages.label: Local message archive
settings.archive_messages.description: Let the helper keep its encrypted local copy of fetched messages.
settings.identity_user_id.label: Identity user ID
settings.identity_user_id.description: Your human Slack user ID, used to resolve "mine", unread and mentions while a bot token is in use.
settings.token_preference.label: Token
settings.token_preference.description: Which stored Slack token the helper should use.
settings.show_count.label: Show unread count
settings.show_count.description: Draw the unread number next to the bar glyph.
settings.glyph_color.label: Glyph colour
settings.glyph_color.description: Colour of the bar glyph when nothing is unread.
settings.unread_color.label: Unread colour
settings.unread_color.description: Colour of the bar glyph and count when something is unread.
